variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by a company in the colony.
variants.body:
A company has laid off many workers in {colony}. The scale is described as large, but a specific number is not supplied here. In assessing {target}, readers should distinguish the loss of jobs from an invented cause, severance arrangement or account of what will happen to those affected.

We hold {target} to account critically. A large loss of jobs is not a minor adjustment in the lives of workers, and its stewardship deserves a more demanding standard than a convenient abstraction.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.sub: The colony has seen a company carry out a large layoff.
variants.body:
Many workers have been laid off by a company. The event puts employment at the centre of the colony's business news. For {target}, the relevant scrutiny concerns responsibility towards people and the handling of work, without assuming either the company's trade or its financial reasons for the decision.

We hold {target} to account critically. A large loss of jobs is not a minor adjustment in the lives of workers, and its stewardship deserves a more demanding standard than a convenient abstraction.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.sub: A company has laid off many workers in {colony}.
variants.body:
A large layoff has taken place at a company in the colony. The loss of work deserves attention without an embellished account of individual households. Readers judging {target} should be able to consider the seriousness of the event without accepting unreported promises of new employment or support.

We hold {target} to account critically. A large loss of jobs is not a minor adjustment in the lives of workers, and its stewardship deserves a more demanding standard than a convenient abstraction.
